title: Five Men and the Audi Ring
description: Five silhouetted men in top hats and long coats stand in a line on a body of water, collectively holding the glowing golden four-ring Audi logo. In the foreground lies a detailed, dark metallic car hood with the Audi emblem and 'Vorsprung durch Technik' text visible. The background features a dramatic blood-red sunset, lightning-filled sky, and distant mountains.
prompt: Surreal dark artwork shows five mysterious men wearing top hats and long coats standing on water, holding the glowing golden Audi four-ring logo together. In the foreground is the front of a black car with detailed hood and emblem. Dramatic blood-red sunset with lightning across the sky and distant mountains, high contrast black and red color palette, ominous and cinematic atmosphere.
